systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and Civic Promotion (DPACS)
systems.tiers: decentralised to 16 provinces, seven more to follow under the PRET; runs through the ministry's academies, provincial delegations and inspectorates, not local governments

note: An education ministry system run through the ministry's own deconcentrated offices (academies, DPEN, IDENPC, IPEP); the 'local authorities' it names are those field offices. Nothing on communes' offices or their connection.
